numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Profit before tax Q2 2026: ISK 1,545 m. Q2 2025: ISK 2,025 m. Q1 2026: ISK 1,809 m. Differences match calculations.

numerical_claims.claim: After-tax profit fell to ISK 903 million from ISK 1,439 million a year earlier
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: After-tax profit Q2 2026: ISK 903 m. Q2 2025: ISK 1,439 m.

numerical_claims.claim: Net operating income decreased 7.3% year on year to ISK 4,756 million.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Net operating income Q2 2026: ISK 4,756 m. Q2 2025: ISK 5,128 m. Difference: ISK 372 m. (7.3%).

numerical_claims.claim: Net interest income was relatively resilient, rising 1.7% to ISK 3,013 million, as higher interest income from customer lending offset higher funding costs and the effect of a smaller liquidity portfolio.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Net interest income Q2 2026: ISK 3,013 m. Q2 2025: ISK 2,962 m. Increase: ISK 51 m. (1.7%).

numerical_claims.claim: Net interest income fell ISK 253 million from Q1, partly because lower inflation reduced the contribution from the bank’s positive ISK 6.1 billion inflation balance, while the ISK 10.2 billion dividend payment in June and recent bond issuances also weighed on the quarter.
numerical_claims.candidate_value: ISK 253 m. decrease from Q1 2026 (ISK 3,266 m. to ISK 3,013 m.)
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Net interest income Q1 2026: ISK 3,266 m. Q2 2026: ISK 3,013 m. Difference: ISK 253 m. Source cites lower inflation impact, ISK 10.2 bn. dividend, and bond issuances.

numerical_claims.claim: Net interest margin declined to 4.0% from 4.5% in Q1.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Net interest margin Q2 2026: 4.0%. Q1 2026: 4.5%. Decline attributed to lower inflation and dividend payment.

numerical_claims.claim: Net fee and commission income remained the main weakness, falling 26.8% year on year to ISK 1,416 million as subdued equity and fixed-income market activity reduced transaction volumes and client activity.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Net fee and commission income Q2 2026: ISK 1,416 m. Q2 2025: ISK 1,935 m. Decrease: ISK 519 m. (26.8%). Source attributes to subdued market activity.

numerical_claims.claim: Other net operating income increased to ISK 327 million from ISK 231 million, supported by stronger net financial income and other operating income.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Other net operating income Q2 2026: ISK 327 m. Q2 2025: ISK 231 m. Increase supported by net financial income and other operating income.

numerical_claims.claim: Administrative expenses declined 1.1% to ISK 2,947 million despite a one-off ISK 112 million restructuring charge.
numerical_claims.candidate_value: ISK 2,947 m. (Q2 2026) vs ISK 2,981 m. (Q2 2025) [1.1% decrease] with ISK 112 m. one-off charge
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Administrative expenses Q2 2026: ISK 2,947 m. Q2 2025: ISK 2,981 m. One-off restructuring charge of ISK 112 m. in June.

numerical_claims.claim: Organisational changes reduced employee numbers to 232, and the efficiency programme is expected to lower the annual cost base by ISK 300–400 million.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Employee count decreased to 232 at end of Q2. Efficiency measures expected to achieve annualised cost savings of ISK 300-400 m.

numerical_claims.claim: Net impairment increased to ISK 269 million from ISK 122 million, reflecting a more conservative loan-book review and heightened economic uncertainty, although management said underlying credit quality remained strong.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Net impairment Q2 2026: ISK (269) m. Q2 2025: ISK (122) m. Management states credit quality remains strong with well-collateralised Stage 3 loans.

numerical_claims.claim: For the first six months, pre-tax profit from continuing operations increased 23.0% to ISK 3,354 million.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Pre-tax profit from continuing operations 6M 2026: ISK 3,354 m. 6M 2025: ISK 2,726 m. Increase: ISK 628 m. (23.0%).

numerical_claims.claim: Net operating income rose 0.7% to ISK 9,643 million, while administrative expenses fell 1.8%.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Net operating income 6M 2026: ISK 9,643 m. 6M 2025: ISK 9,577 m. Administrative expenses 6M 2026: ISK 5,961 m. 6M 2025: ISK 6,071 m.

numerical_claims.claim: After-tax profit from continuing operations increased to ISK 2,277 million, although total profit for the period declined to ISK 2,277 million from ISK 3,525 million because the prior-year figure included ISK 1,901 million from discontinued operations.
numerical_claims.candidate_value: ISK 2,277 m. (6M 2026 continuing) vs ISK 3,525 m. (6M 2025 total) with ISK 1,901 m. from discontinued ops
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: ISK 2,277 m. (6M 2026 after-tax from continuing) vs ISK 3,525 m. (6M 2025 after-tax total)
numerical_claims.source_evidence: After-tax profit from continuing operations 6M 2026: ISK 2,277 m. Total profit for period 6M 2025: ISK 3,525 m. (includes ISK 1,901 m. from discontinued operations).

numerical_claims.claim: Loans to customers increased 7.6% from year-end 2025 to ISK 223.3 billion, while deposits rose 16.5% to ISK 201.2 billion.
numerical_claims.candidate_value: ISK 223.3 bn. loans (7.6% YoY); ISK 201.2 bn. deposits (16.5% YoY)
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: ISK 223.3 bn. loans (7.6% from YE 2025); ISK 201.2 bn. deposits (16.5% from YE 2025)
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Loans to customers Q2 2026: ISK 223.3 bn. (+7.6% from YE 2025). Deposits Q2 2026: ISK 201.2 bn. (+16.5% from YE 2025).

numerical_claims.claim: Total assets increased 9.5% to ISK 375.7 billion.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Total assets Q2 2026: ISK 375.7 bn. Increase: 9.5% from YE 2025.

numerical_claims.claim: Capital and liquidity remained strong, with a 23.0% capital adequacy ratio, an LCR of 276% and an NSFR of 137%.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
